import json, hashlib, subprocess, datetime

import numpy as np
rng=np.random.default_rng(778102)
max_projection_error=0.; max_displacement_error=0.; min_slack=float('inf')
for _ in range(40):
 X=rng.normal(size=(12,2)); z=rng.normal(size=(12,2)); Z=np.column_stack([z,z[:,0]])
 y=rng.normal(size=12); e=rng.normal(size=12)
 M=np.eye(12)-Z@np.linalg.pinv(Z); S=X.T@M@X
 p=np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack([X,Z]),y,rcond=None)[0][:2]
 ph=np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack([X,Z]),y-e,rcond=None)[0][:2]
 err=np.linalg.norm(ph-p+np.linalg.solve(S,X.T@M@e)); max_projection_error=max(max_projection_error,float(err)); assert err<1e-12
 A=rng.normal(size=(12,4)); P=A.T@A; w,V=np.linalg.eigh(P)
 ir=(V/w**.5)@V.T; root=(V*w**.5)@V.T
 D=rng.normal(size=A.shape); D*=.65/np.linalg.norm(D@ir,2); B=A+D
 e0=rng.normal(size=12); b=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]; bh=np.linalg.lstsq(B,y-e0,rcond=None)[0]
 r=A@b-y; d=D@b+e0; dg=A.T@d+D.T@r+D.T@d
 err=np.linalg.norm(bh-b+np.linalg.solve(B.T@B,dg)); max_displacement_error=max(max_displacement_error,float(err)); assert err<1e-12
 eps=np.linalg.norm(D@ir,2); eig=np.linalg.eigvalsh(ir@B.T@B@ir); j=rng.normal(size=4)
 v=j@np.linalg.solve(P,j); vh=j@np.linalg.solve(B.T@B,j); bound=np.linalg.norm(ir@dg)/(1-eps)**2
 slacks=[eig.min()-(1-eps)**2,(1+eps)**2-eig.max(),vh-v/(1+eps)**2,v/(1-eps)**2-vh,bound-np.linalg.norm(root@(bh-b)),np.sqrt(v)*bound-abs(j@(bh-b))]
 min_slack=min(min_slack,*map(float,slacks)); assert min(slacks)>-1e-12
counterexample=[]
for ys in ([1.],[1.,3.]):

 counterexample.append(dict(N=len(ys),y=ys,baseline=float(b),approximate=float(bh),displacement=float(bh-b),formal_covariance=float(1/(B.T@B)[0,0])))
assert abs(counterexample[0]['displacement']+1/3)<1e-12
assert abs(counterexample[1]['displacement']+2/3)<1e-12
